definitions.gloss: what on earth, what in the world
definitions.explanation: Used in questions to express surprise, confusion, or emphasis.
A single unified body or entity.

examples.japanese: {一体|いったい}{何|なに}が{起|お}きたの？
{一体|いったい}どこに{行|い}くつもりですか？
examples.english: Where in the world are you planning to go?

examples.japanese: {心身|しんしん}{一体|いったい}となる。

notes:
{一体|いったい} has two main uses: as an emphatic question word and as a noun meaning unity/body.

USAGE AS ADVERB:
- {一体|いったい} + question word (何、どこ、誰、etc.)
- Adds emphasis or frustration to questions
- "What on earth," "who in the world," etc.

USAGE AS NOUN:
- {一体|いったい}となる (become one)
- {一体|いったい}{感|かん} (sense of unity)
- {心身|しんしん}{一体|いったい} (unity of mind and body)
